symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1653: `create java action` with a `/** … */` doc comment wrote a .java file without the class javadoc mxbuild generates from the documentation, and `create or modify java action` removed the block Studio Pro wrote; the next build put it back (diff there and back in git)
cause: javaactions.GenerateSource had no documentation argument and wrote the imports, a blank line, then `public class …`; WriteJavaSourceFile (backend interface, modelsdk, mock, generated stubs) did not pass it either, although the executor had ja.Documentation at hand
file: sdk/javaactions/source.go (GenerateSource, writeClassJavadoc), mdl/backend/java.go + modelsdk/java_write.go + mock (WriteJavaSourceFile), mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions.go
insight: GenerateSource aims at byte-identical output with mxbuild, so anything mxbuild derives from the model (here the documentation) must reach it, not only what MDL states about the file. Pass the documentation as stored on the action after the carry rule (stated doc comment, else the stored one), so a rewrite without a doc comment keeps the block. After changing a backend interface method, regenerate unimplemented_gen.go (go run ./mdl/backend/modelsdk/gen_unimplemented.go) and unsupported_gen.go (go generate in mdl/backend/mcp).
